Confirmed the call site in `CreateMemo` handler at `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:157`.

q22. `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:15` (called from the `CreateMemo` handler at `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:157`); delivery package: `internal/webhook` (via `webhook.PostAsync`/`webhook.Post` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`); signing mechanism: Standard Webhooks–style HMAC-SHA256 signature — an HMAC-SHA256 over `msgID + "." + timestamp + "." + body` keyed by the per-webhook signing secret (base64-decoded if prefixed `whsec_`), sent as base64 in the `webhook-signature: v1,<sig>` header alongside `webhook-id` and `webhook-timestamp` headers (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:97-150`).
